testDefinitions.displayName: Identification of Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate (ammonium oxalate and ammonium molybdate)
testDefinitions.notes: Test 1: Dissolve with heating 0.1 g in 10 mL dilute HCl, add 2.5 mL dilute ammonia R1, shake, add 5 mL 35 g/L ammonium oxalate solution: white precipitate is produced. Test 2: Dissolve 0.1 g in 5 mL dilute nitric acid, add 2 mL ammonium molybdate solution, heat at 70 °C for 2 min: yellow precipitate is produced. BP 2024 Monograph for Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate (source: Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate__New 1-2_STM Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate - New.txt:32).

testDefinitions.notes: Dissolve 5.0 g (W1) in 40 mL water + 10 mL hydrochloric acid, boil 5 min, collect insoluble substances on ashless filter paper, wash with water until AgNO3 test negative, ignite at 600 ± 50 °C. Residue weighs not more than 10 mg (0.2%). Formula: (residue / W1) x 100. BP 2024 Monograph for Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate (source: Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate__New 1-2_STM Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate - New.txt:33).

testDefinitions.notes: Shake 0.5 g with 5 mL carbon dioxide-free water. Add 1 mL hydrochloric acid: no effervescence is produced. testDefinitions.displayName: Arsenic (limit test, Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate)
testDefinitions.notes: BP Appendix VII Limit Tests, Arsenic (Method A). Solution S: 2.5 g in 20 mL dilute HCl, dilute ammonia R1 to precipitate, dilute HCl to redissolve, dilute to 50 mL with water. Test solution: 2 mL solution S to 25 mL with water + 15 mL HCl + 0.1 mL stannous chloride solution + 5 mL potassium iodide solution; stand 15 min; add 5 g activated zinc. Assemble apparatus, immerse flask in water-bath. Reference solution: 1 mL arsenic standard solution (1 ppm As) to 25 mL with water, same reagents. After at least 2 h, colour in test solution is not more intense than standard. Limit NMT 10 ppm (source: Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate__New 1-2_STM Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate - New.txt:37).

testDefinitions.notes: To 0.5 g add 10 mL water, heat to boiling; while stirring add 1 mL hydrochloric acid dropwise; allow to cool and filter if necessary; add 2 mL of a 10 g/L solution of dipotassium sulfate; allow to stand for 10 min: no turbidity is produced. BP 2024 Monograph for Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate (source: Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate__New 1-2_STM Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate - New.txt:38).

testDefinitions.displayName: Loss on ignition (Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate)
testDefinitions.notes: Accurately weighed empty crucible, previously ignited at 800-825 °C and cooled in desiccator (W0). Weigh accurately 1.000 g into crucible (W1 = tare + sample). Ignite in calibrated muffle at 800-825 °C for 2 h, cool in desiccator, weigh (W2). Repeat to constant weight. % loss on ignition = (W1 - W2) / (W1 - W0) x 100. Limit 24.5% to 26.5%. BP 2024 Monograph for Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate (source: Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate__New 1-2_STM Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate - New.txt:40).

testDefinitions.displayName: Assay of Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate (complexometric back titration)
testDefinitions.titrationEquivalencyFactorDerivation: Stated in STM: 1 mL of 0.02 M sodium edetate is equivalent to 3.44 mg of Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate (3.44 mg / 0.02 M = 172.0 mg/mmol, MW 172.09 g/mol)
testDefinitions.notes: BP Appendix VIII D Complexometric Titrations. Dissolve 0.4 g in 12 mL dilute HCl (heat on water bath if necessary), dilute to 200 mL with water. To 20.0 mL add 25.0 mL 0.02 M sodium edetate, 50 mL water, 5 mL ammonium chloride buffer pH 10.7, ~25 mg mordant black 11 triturate. Titrate excess edetate with 0.02 M zinc sulfate with blank titration. 1 mL 0.02 M edetate = 3.44 mg CaHPO4.2H2O (F = 172.09 mg/mmol). Note: titrant 0.02 M Zinc sulfate VS is complete: false (no standardization stated in STM; source: Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate__New 1-2_STM Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate - New.txt:28,41).

testDefinitions.displayName: Particle size distribution (sieving / analyser, Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate)
testDefinitions.notes: Calibrated analytical sieving or particle size analyser; measure mass percentage of powder in each sieve size range (D10 125 µm / 10% pass through 120 mesh; D50 250 µm / 50% pass through 60 mesh; D90 500 µm / 90% pass through 35 mesh). Qualitative rows per in-house specification by R&D department (source: Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate__New 1-2_STM Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate - New.txt:42).

testDefinitions.notes: Assay per UV spectrophotometry: weigh about 350 mg sample into 50 mL flask, disperse in water to 50 mL. Dilute 1 mL to 100 mL with acetone; dilute 5 mL of that to 50 mL with acetone (final dilution 50000). Measure absorbance at 456 nm and 800 nm against acetone. % beta-carotene = (A456 - A800) x 50000 / (2500 x W), where W is sample weight (g), 2500 = A1% 1 cm in acetone. Net absorbance A = A456 - A800 recorded by analyst (source: Natural betacarotene 20%__STM for Natural betacarotene 20% new without micro.txt:35).

solutions.name: 0.02 M Disodium edetate VS
solutions.instructions: Dissolve 7.444 g of disodium edetate in sufficient water to produce 1000 ml. Standardize against 0.100 g of zinc granules dissolved in 4 mL 7M hydrochloric acid, diluted to 100 mL, 25 mL diluted to 200 mL, add ~50 mg xylenol orange triturate and hexamine until violet-pink plus 2 g excess, titrate to yellow endpoint (1 mL 0.02 M disodium edetate = 1.308 mg Zn).
solutions.notes: Recipe from STM: 7.444 g in 1000 mL water. Standardized against zinc granules (1 mL 0.02 M EDTA = 1.308 mg Zn). House defaults applied: 3 replicates, factor 0.97-1.03, max RSD 0.2 %, valid 30 days, shelf life 30 days, storage condition "Tightly closed, room temperature" (source: Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate__New 1-2_STM Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate - New.txt:28).

solutions.name: 0.02 M Zinc sulfate VS
solutions.instructions: Dissolve 5.8 g of zinc sulfate in water and dilute to 1000.0 mL with the same solvent.
solutions.notes: Dissolve 5.8 g of zinc sulfate in water and dilute to 1000.0 mL with the same solvent. Used as back-titrant in Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate complexometric assay. Complete: false because STM states no standardization procedure, shelf life, or storage condition (source: Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate__New 1-2_STM Calcium Hydrogen Phosphate Dihydrate - New.txt:28).
